description: This Java abstract class 'CommandControl' defines a UI component for executing commands, including UI element setup and event handling.

classes.name: CommandControl
classes.description: An abstract class representing a UI control element with command execution capabilities, including label, icon, and button.

methods.name: CommandControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components with label, icon, and button, setting up layout and event listener.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Creates an ActionListener that sends the command via CommandQueue when the button is pressed.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the command string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the UI component containing the control.
